name: dbt-ci-failure-responder
description: Responds to dbt Cloud job failures by creating a Jira bug ticket and invoking the SDD bug-fix workflow in scheduled mode.

trigger.description: Fired by dbt Cloud when a job run fails. Configure the dbt Cloud webhook to POST to the Cortex Code Automations endpoint for this automation.

filter.description: Only trigger for the target scheduled jobs (daily, 30min, hourly). Filter by job name pattern if the account has other jobs that should not trigger auto-fix.

context.workingDirectory: The dbt project root (where AGENTS.md lives)
context.notes: The webhook payload is passed as automation context to the skill. The skill parses it via the dbt-cloud-parser agent and proceeds autonomously.

runner.description: Standalone Python webhook server using the Cortex Code Agent SDK. Receives dbt Cloud events and invokes the skill headlessly.

dbt_cloud.description: Store your dbt Cloud service token: `cortex secret store dbt_cloud_token --from-file <path>`. The token needs Read access to jobs and runs.

dbt_cloud_webhook.description: In dbt Cloud: Account Settings → Webhooks → Create Webhook. Event: 'Run errored'. Endpoint: the Cortex Code Automations webhook URL provided when this automation is registered.
